_comment: Hand-maintained relationship source data for the GRC Documentation Library:
a nodes registry (the resolvable node entries: id, display_name, class, and
optional source_identifier and corpus_path) plus the relationship records.
every record must use the controlled verb vocabulary, the node-class taxonomy,
and the field shape of that framework's illustrative machine-readable record,
and every record endpoint must resolve to a node registered here (the
endpoint class is repeated inline and validated to equal the registry
node's class). Real authority and corpus identifiers are permitted in the
library's own nodes and records; no third-party text is reproduced. This is
the library's own relationship data; adopters are not required to adopt it.
Regenerate the derived model with python3 tools/build-relationship-model.py
